GuestProfile.title: GuestProfile
GuestProfile.description: Profile details for each authenticated guest, containing check-in status and preferences.

userId.description: Unique identifier matching the Firebase Auth UID.

guestName.description: Public name or nickname of the guest.

roomNumber.description: Room or suite number corresponding to their check-in details.

favoriteBuildings.description: List of building IDs marked as favorite by the guest.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last profile update.

NavigationSession.title: NavigationSession
NavigationSession.description: Log of a single navigation session where a guest initiates or completes directions to a building.

userId.description: UID of the guest who ran the navigation.

buildingName.description: Name of the target building in English or Arabic.

distanceMeters.description: Distance computed at start or finish.

completed.description: Whether the guest successfully reached the destination.

BuildingTip.title: BuildingTip
BuildingTip.description: Social crowdsourced tips or comments written by guests for a particular building.

buildingId.description: ID of the building the tip is posted for.

userId.description: UID of the author who wrote the tip.

caption.description: Content text of the tip, restricted to 200 characters max.

ResortPlace.title: ResortPlace
ResortPlace.description: A custom dynamic or modified resort building/spot added or edited by the administrator.

nameAr.description: Arabic display name of the place.

nameEn.description: English display name of the place.

guests/{userId}.description: Stores guest profile settings and checked-in information.

sessions/{sessionId}.description: Logs guest wayfinding sessions for statistics and history.

tips/{tipId}.description: Community tips and reviews submitted by guests on hotel buildings.

places/{placeId}.description: Customized and added resort structures in charmillion.
